summary: Updated edit-embedded-office-xml/SKILL.md to incorporate two high-signal patterns from the trace: (1) explicit handling of config files (e.g., live_embedding.json) to identify target embeddings among multiple candidates, and (2) a fallback rule to use the deterministic XML script when openpyxl alters workbook structure and triggers strict verifier failures. Added these as critical decision rules and anti-patterns to prevent future agents from guessing targets or relying on openpyxl when structural parity is required.
